This walk through is meant to start working on building a pipeline to analyze 16s rDNA from eDNA results to indicate the presence of vulernable/endangered/rare species in the James River watershed, specifically the Appomattox. It seems that first of all there is not an R based base-caller as of now so we'll have to start with Guppy or Bonito to perform base-calling, and then we can use DESeq2 to perform downstream analysis. See below for steps for DESeq2 installation.

```{r, echo=TRUE}

if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("DESeq2")

# install BiocManager, and DESeq2.

browseVignettes("DESeq2")

# look at Vigenette for reference
```
